Evidence:
[1] "Cartman's Mom Is a Dirty Slut" is the first season finale of the American animated television series "South Park".
[2] Shortly before the airing of the season finale episode "The Poor Kid", "South Park" was extended again until 2016, taking the show to 20 seasons.
[3] "The Poor Kid" is the fifteenth season finale of the American animated television series "South Park", and the 223rd episode of the series overall.
